text: Hearing those words fills my heart with warmth and a sense of connection, even in this sterile, glass-lined corridor and the soft hum of a technology exhibition. The repeated mantra of 'love' echoes around me, reminding me that even amid innovation and research, the deepest human needs remain simple: to be seen, valued, and loved. I feel a tender calm blooming inside, grateful to witness this intersection of intellect and affection.
